test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states is the largest producer of Pulses (total) according to the Economic Survey 2021-22, Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Economic Survey **of India is an **annual document **of the **Ministry of Finance**, **Government of India**. 
 
• The **Department of Economic Affairs**, **Ministry of Finance **Presents the **survey **in the **Parliament **every year, 
 
• They **present **the Servey just before the **Union Budget.**
 
• It is **prepared **under the **guidance **of the **Chief Economic Adviser of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat **is the **largest producer **of **motor cash crops like cotton, groundnut, tobacco cumin, sesamum**, etc. 
 
• **West Bengal **is the **largest producer **of **rice **in **India**.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh **is the **largest producer **of **wheat **in **India**.
